description:
Basic Qualifications:  
 

 * The candidate needs to have at least a Bachelor's degree and 9 years of related IT work experience. 9 years of experience with a high school diploma or college course work may be substituted for a degree. 
 

 * Demonstrable graphic design skills with a strong portfolio 
 

 * Solid experience in creating wireframes, storyboards, user flows, process flows and site maps 
 

 * Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, or other visual design and wire-framing tools 
 

 * Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for rapid prototyping 
 

 * Excellent visual design skills with sensitivity to user-system interaction 
 

 * Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively 
 

 * Up-to-date with the latest Web trends, techniques, and technologies 
 

 * Good team working skills and meticulous attention to detail is a must 
 

 * Understanding of web standards, accessibility, (Section 508), and usability 
 

 * Must be able to obtain a USPS clearance 
 

 * Possess expertise in using Adobe Creative Suite and basic proficiency in HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript 
 

 * 9 years in proven Web Design experience
 


 HTML, CSS,UX, Web Design,Adobe, Agile 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
